reply: Thanks for checking in! Yes, that up-front annual charge is exactly the discounted plan. When you bill annually instead of monthly, Loopwise applies a 20% discount compared to the monthly rate, and that discounted amount is charged as a single lump sum for the year rather than spread out month to month. So the full charge you saw is the annual total already reflecting that 20% savings — there isn't a separate discount applied on top of it. Let me know if you'd like me to pull up the specific numbers on your invoice for comparison.
